headline: How to get the Korean 'water glow' look

scenes.say: Today's Korean beauty word: mul-gwang (물광). Mul-gwang means water glow, that fresh, dewy shine Koreans love. Here's how to get the look in three easy steps.
First, pat a hydrating toner into damp skin in two or three thin layers, not one heavy splash.
scenes.label: Step 1

scenes.say: Next, mix one drop of facial oil into your moisturizer, then press it in with your palms.
scenes.label: Step 2

scenes.say: Then use a dewy cushion foundation, and tap a little balm on your cheekbones and nose bridge.
scenes.label: Step 3

scenes.say: The common mistake? Shine all over the face. Keep it on the high points, so it looks glowy, not greasy.
scenes.label: Common mistake

scenes.say: Save this for your next glow day. The shopping link is in my profile.
